name: compact-capture-headers
goal: Comparison cards show revision identity without capture labels or duplicate full-size controls; clicking images still opens them.

evidence: Remove capture-status captions and duplicate Open full size buttons from the shared comparison header; image activation and revision roles stay available.

Existing overview tests required Focused capture and activated the redundant text button. Strengthen the normal visual matrix and focused fixture to require revision-only captions, and verify image pointer and keyboard activation in the existing page flow.
